_comment: Copy this file (e.g. to send_messages.json), edit the values, then: .venv/bin/python examples/send_dms_as_users.py --config send_messages.json --manifest sent.json. Each sender_email MUST be a persona you authorized in Step 5 (look at the keys under 'users' in tokens.json to see which personas are available). recipient_user_id is the Slack user ID (starts with U) of the person who should RECEIVE the DM — usually Jennifer Hynes (or your primary demo persona).

messages.text: Quick one — where do we land on the Acme renewal? Need a best/most-likely for the Q2 board readout by EOD tomorrow.
Got your discount request for Acme — need exec approval on anything past 18%. Can you grab a quick justification before I route it?
